raid_ap_contribution.note: Checked Shadow Weaving/Vampiric Touch/Shadow Word: Pain for any real 'grants OTHER players a stat, invisible to a solo sim' mechanic - none found. Shadow Weaving is a self-only proc-based spell-damage-taken debuff on the target (enemy-side, already benefits a solo sim directly, same class of effect as Sunder Armor/Faerie Fire), not a raid-AP-style grant.

apl_note: A second real file, test.apl.json, exists alongside default.apl.json but is never imported anywhere in presets.ts (only DefaultApl = default.apl.json is) - confirmed dev fixture, not a second real rotation, same as the plan flagged checking for.
weapon_topology_note: Confirmed via real handType data across all 4 real gear files: pre_raid/P1/P2 use a real handType=1 (MainHand, one-handed) weapon + a real offhand item (Orb of the Soul-Eater); P3's real BiS switches to a handType=4 (TwoHand) staff (Zhar'doom, Greatstaff of the Devourer) with no offhand - genuinely phase-varying, same pattern already found for Balance Druid, not two_hand like Feral Cat Druid.
stat_weights_note: Real EP weights from priest/dps/presets.ts - TWO real presets exist (P1_EP_PRESET, P3_EP_PRESET) with meaningfully different Hit/Haste weights (P3's real MeleeH... SpellHitRating 1.35 vs P1's 1.18, SpellHasteRating 0.88 vs 0.69 - later-phase itemization shifts priorities). Used P3_EP_PRESET as the single canonical set, matching this tool's own phase3-primary convention (every synthetic test character is seeded from p3 gear; phase3 is the default sweep target) - P1's own preset is real but not used here, noted so it isn't silently lost.
gear_variant_note: Only P1-P3 (+ pre_raid.gear.json) real gear_sets exist for Priest in this sim version - no P4/P5 data, same real gap already found for Rogue.
class_options_note: PriestOptions has real armor/use_shadowfiend/pre_shadowform fields, but presets.ts's own DefaultOptions only sets preShadowform: true - armor and use_shadowfiend are left at their real proto defaults (NoArmor, false) since presets.ts doesn't set them either. Priest.Rotation is a real, empty {} proto message - no per-spec rotation config exists (unlike Feral Cat Druid), everything real is APL-driven (Shadowfiend summon included, verify via combat log).
raid_buffs_overlay_note: Left empty, same as Balance Druid/Elemental Shaman - Priest's own real DefaultPartyBuffs (manaSpringTotem/wrathOfAirTotem, a caster-group totem set) differs from the shared baseline's melee-group totems, but every prior caster profile already made the same call to keep raid comp assumptions uniform across all profiles for comparability rather than tailor per-class, so this isn't a new deviation.
